row:
Downtown Dog Rescue is an all volunteer run 501C3 nonprofit organization that believes in second chances for both dogs and people. We rescue dogs and provide services for low income pet owners in under served communities in Los Angeles County.
Visit www.downtowndogrescue.org to learn more about our programs and on how to adopt a dog from DDR.
